title: sida carnea
intro: Sida carnea, commonly known as the country mallow or poor man's cotton, is a perennial herb native to tropical America. It is rich in health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which help in reducing fever and relieving symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Sida carnea include its use as an expectorant to relieve coughs and bronchitis, as well as its application in traditional medicine for its antiseptic and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Sida carnea include flavonoids, saponins, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
